question: What temperature did sensor 20.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 00:58:47?

graph.cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 20.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T00:58:47"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
